title: Jill Thompson
description: Jabba the Hutt has a sore throat, courtesy of Princess-turned-slave-girl Leia. "STAR WARS was the first 'real' movie I ever saw at the theater," reflects Jill Thompson, "so it's a great feeling to illustrate something that is a part of my childhood memories." Over the past number of years, Thompson has illustrated comics for various publishers. Titles include SANDMAN, WONDER WOMAN, the new BLACK ORCHID for DC and THE SCARLET LETTER for Classics Illustrated. Her most recent project is THE BADGER from Dark Horse.
